title: Ohio and US asset poverty: original Scorecard history
description: Two household financial-cushion measures with explicit missing/suppressed years.
methodology: Use original trend values. Remove only binary floating-point representation residue at the published one-decimal scale; retain exact original response. -1 is missing/suppressed, not zero. _moe is a literal source field; no confidence interval is reconstructed.
